body:
## Summary

Composes rohanarun's #1297 four helper-donor cold kernels (pivots 531/543/555/567; 531 from Jeremy Kothe's #1274) with the multi-donor idle rank-48 exchange overlay (#1252 method, generalised to donor stars in #1268/#1280): 3,251 donors and 5,025 receivers turn idle H48=11374 into H42=1774, H45=1477, H48=3098, H51=5025 with axis unions, owners and dispatch unchanged.
